title: 2.8.1.1  Objectif 8. Autosens is ON but it is not
symptom: After starting objective 8, the Autosens setting is ON in settings, but the OpenAPS SMB page shows Autosens as not activated. Toggling the setting OFF and ON makes it appear activated.
cause: The OpenAPS SMB tab was still showing data from the last loop run before activating the objective; it resolves with the next loop run.
fix: No fix needed; the issue resolves after the next loop run. The maintainer suggests toggling the setting may have been coincidental.
evidence_quote: Then it is highly likely that the OpenAPS SMB tab was still showing the data from the last loop run before activating the objective. I tried to reproduce it and with the next loop it resolves as expected.
